title: External Tools & Web Integration
summary: This module integrates external web search capabilities and provides browser-like tools for navigating and interacting with web content. It includes components for executing web searches, opening URLs, and managing tool dispatch.

nodes.label: External Web Search API
nodes.title: External Web Search API
nodes.description: A third-party service endpoint (e.g., Ollama's web search) that provides raw search results.

nodes.label: Anthropic Web Search Client
nodes.title: Anthropic Web Search Client
nodes.description: Handles making authenticated HTTP requests to the external web search API and parsing its responses. Implements the core logic for web search.

nodes.label: Web Search Tool
nodes.title: Web Search Tool
nodes.description: Provides a standardized interface for performing web searches, often wrapping a specific client like the Anthropic one for use by other tools.

nodes.label: Browser Search Tool
nodes.title: Browser Search Tool
nodes.description: Manages the browser's search functionality, using a Web Search Tool to fetch results and then formatting them into browsable pages for the user.

nodes.label: Browser Navigation Tool
nodes.title: Browser Navigation Tool
nodes.description: Enables opening specific URLs or navigating through links within the browser's current state, potentially crawling new pages if not cached.

nodes.label: Application Tool Dispatcher
nodes.title: Application Tool Dispatcher
nodes.description: A centralized registry for `app.tools` components, enabling dynamic execution of registered tools based on their names and arguments.

nodes.label: Extended Tools Dispatcher
nodes.title: Extended Tools Dispatcher
nodes.description: Manages and dispatches tools from the `x.tools` package, providing a structured way to invoke them within the system.

nodes.label: Test Browser Functionality
nodes.title: Test Browser Functionality
nodes.description: Contains unit and integration tests for the browser search and open functionalities, ensuring correct behavior and state management.

nodes.label: Test X Tools Registry
nodes.title: Test X Tools Registry
nodes.description: Tests the functionality of the `x.tools` registry, including tool registration and execution, verifying correct dispatching.

nodes.label: Test Web Search Tool
nodes.title: Test Web Search Tool
nodes.description: Tests the `WebSearchTool` component, verifying its input validation and interaction with underlying search mechanisms.

groups.label: Web Search Integration
groups.title: Web Search Integration
groups.description: Components responsible for integrating and performing web searches, including the client for external APIs and the tool interface.

groups.label: Browser Tools
groups.title: Browser Tools
groups.description: Tools that simulate browser functionality, enabling search, navigation, and content display within the application.

groups.label: Tool Registries
groups.title: Tool Registries
groups.description: Centralized systems for registering and dispatching various tools, allowing for flexible and extensible tool management.
